document:
To: Office of Protocol, Ministry of External Affairs, Republic of Calder
Subject: Arrival logistics for the Commissioner's delegation, 4-6 November

Further to your request, please find the delegation's movements below so your security service can coordinate.
Commissioner A. Lindqvist and two advisers land on flight KX 214 at 14:10 on 4 November, Terminal 2.
Motorcade route: airport expressway, north bridge, then Harbour Road to the Hotel Arden (rooms 1204-1206).
Our close-protection officer, R. Osei, will travel in the second vehicle. The delegation departs 6 November at 07:30.
